context: This criteria evaluates the correct implementation of authentication mechanisms including HTTP Basic Authentication and Bearer token authentication.

checklist.name: Basic authentication
checklist.description: Correctly implements HTTP Basic Authentication by passing username and password to the authentication method

checklist.name: Bearer token
checklist.description: Correctly implements Bearer token authentication by configuring the authentication with token and appropriate type

checklist.name: Error handling
checklist.description: Properly handles authentication failures and unauthorized responses
